sop.title: Direct Startup-to-Government Procurement Gateway
sop.subtitle: Architected to dismantle red tape and eliminate legacy tender barriers. Fast-track your deep-tech solutions into active state governance across four transparent phases.

stage1.title: DPIIT & MSME Onboarding
stage1.desc: Authenticate your entity using DPIIT Recognition, GSTIN, and CIN. Zero security deposit (EMD) required for accredited startups.

stage2.title: Targeted Challenge Bid
stage2.desc: Apply directly to published departmental problem statements. Proposals are evaluated purely on technical merit and innovation efficacy.

stage3.title: Paid Field Trial & PoC
stage3.desc: Receive sanctioned milestone grants (up to ₹25 Lakhs) to deploy your pilot across actual district municipal environments over 90 days.

stage4.title: GeM Work Order Award
stage4.desc: Validated innovations bypass prior-turnover hurdles and receive direct state commercial purchase orders under Maharashtra Innovation Policy.

chatbot.fallback: I can only answer the predefined questions listed above for this demonstration.
chatbot.welcome: Hello. I am the Portal Assistant. How can I help you today?
chatbot.q1: How do I register as a Startup?
chatbot.a1: To register, click the 'Sign In' or 'Register' button at the top right. You will need your company details, DPIIT recognition number, and PAN card.
chatbot.a2: Once you submit a solution to a challenge, it is first screened for eligibility, then evaluated by a technical expert committee. If shortlisted, you will be invited for a pilot.
chatbot.a3: Pilots are generally funded by the respective government department based on the financial estimate you provide during your application, subject to committee approval.
chatbot.q4: What is a DPIIT recognition number?
chatbot.a4: It is a unique number issued by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) to eligible startups in India.

processPage.pageDesc: Understanding the end-to-end evidence-based procurement process under the Maharashtra IT Policy 2026. This framework ensures transparency, rigorous evaluation, and rapid deployment of scalable solutions.
processPage.p1_s1_desc: Startups must register using their DPIIT recognition number and PAN. The system automatically verifies credentials against central databases.
processPage.p1_s2_desc: Startups browse the Challenge Registry and select problem statements that align with their core technological competencies.
processPage.p1_s3_desc: Submission of a detailed Technical Architecture, Financial Estimate for the pilot, and Data Privacy compliance certificates.
processPage.p2_s1_desc: An expert committee reviews the technical feasibility, scalability, and security architecture of the proposed solution.
processPage.p2_s2_desc: Shortlisted startups are called for presentations. The department sanctions an initial budget to conduct a live pilot.
processPage.p2_s3_desc: If the pilot successfully meets the predefined KPIs, the department issues a direct procurement order under the IT Policy mandate.

matrixRows.r1_c3: Readiness of the technology, architecture robustness, and security standards.
matrixRows.r2_c3: Cost-effectiveness of the pilot and scalability costs for statewide deployment.
matrixRows.r3_c3: Direct benefit to citizens and alignment with departmental goals.
matrixRows.r4_c3: Prior experience, DPIIT status, and execution capability of the startup team.

raiseTicket.pageDesc: Identify an operational challenge or issue in public services? Raise a ticket here. Valid submissions will be reviewed by government departments and may be posted as official innovation challenges.
raiseTicket.note: Note: This form is for proposing new problem statements and highlighting public operational issues. Do not use this form for technical support regarding the portal itself.
raiseTicket.titlePlaceholder: E.g., Inefficient traffic management at major intersections
raiseTicket.descSub: Please explain the operational challenge, who is affected, and why it requires an innovative solution.
raiseTicket.successMessage: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. Your issue has been logged with ticket ID
raiseTicket.successReview: The relevant government department will review your submission. If validated, this may be published as a new challenge for startups to solve.
